model.my_dbt_project.mart_delivery_kpi.name: mart_delivery_kpi
model.my_dbt_project.mart_delivery_kpi.description: KPI доставок: сроки, стоимость, статусы по модальностям.
model.my_dbt_project.mart_delivery_kpi.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='table',
    engine='OLAP',
    keys=['transport_mode', 'container_type', 'priority'],
    table_type='PRIMARY',
    distributed_by=['transport_mode'],
    buckets=4,
    properties='{"replication_num": "1"}'
) }}

WITH shipments AS (
    SELECT
        s.shipment_id,
        s.supply_order_id,
        s.ship_date,
        s.delivery_date,
        COALESCE(s.transport_mode, 'unknown')    AS transport_mode,
        COALESCE(s.container_type, 'unknown')    AS container_type,
        COALESCE(o.priority, 'unknown')          AS priority,
        s.weight_kg,
        s.shipping_cost,
        s.status,
        DATEDIFF(s.delivery_date, s.ship_date)   AS delivery_days
    FROM {{ ref('stg_shipments') }} s
    LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_supply_orders') }} o
        ON o.supply_order_id = s.supply_order_id
)
SELECT
    transport_mode,
    container_type,
    priority,
    COUNT(*)                                          AS shipments_count,
    SUM(weight_kg)                                    AS total_weight_kg,
    SUM(shipping_cost)                                AS total_shipping_cost,
    AVG(shipping_cost)                                AS avg_shipping_cost,
    AVG(delivery_days)                                AS avg_delivery_days,
    MIN(delivery_days)                                AS min_delivery_days,
    MAX(delivery_days)                                AS max_delivery_days,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'delivered' THEN 1 END)  AS delivered_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 END)  AS cancelled_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'returned' THEN 1 END)   AS returned_count
FROM shipments
GROUP BY transport_mode, container_type, priority

model.my_dbt_project.mart_payment_summar.name: mart_payment_summary
model.my_dbt_project.mart_payment_summar.description: Сводка по платежам и инвойсам по месяцам и валютам.
model.my_dbt_project.mart_payment_summar.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='table',
    engine='OLAP',
    keys=['month', 'currency'],
    table_type='PRIMARY',
    distributed_by=['month'],
    buckets=4,
    properties='{"replication_num": "1"}'
) }}

WITH invoices AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(invoice_date, '%Y-%m-01')  AS invoice_month,
        currency,
        payment_status,
        COUNT(*)                                AS invoices_count,
        SUM(total_price)                        AS invoices_total
    FROM {{ ref('stg_invoices') }}
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
payments AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(payment_date, '%Y-%m-01')  AS payment_month,
        currency,
        payment_status,
        COUNT(*)                                AS payments_count,
        SUM(total_price)                        AS payments_total
    FROM {{ ref('stg_payments') }}
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(i.invoice_month, p.payment_month) AS month,
    COALESCE(i.currency, p.currency)           AS currency,
    COALESCE(i.invoices_count, 0)              AS invoices_count,
    COALESCE(i.invoices_total, 0)              AS invoices_total,
    COALESCE(p.payments_count, 0)              AS payments_count,
    COALESCE(p.payments_total, 0)              AS payments_total,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(i.invoices_total, 0) > 0
        THEN ROUND(COALESCE(p.payments_total, 0) / i.invoices_total * 100, 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END                                        AS payment_ratio_pct
FROM invoices i
FULL OUTER JOIN payments p
    ON i.invoice_month = p.payment_month
   AND i.currency = p.currency

model.my_dbt_project.mart_supplier_perfo.name: mart_supplier_performance
model.my_dbt_project.mart_supplier_perfo.description: KPI по каждому поставщику: контракты, заказы, суммы, рейтинг.
model.my_dbt_project.mart_supplier_perfo.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='table',
    engine='OLAP',
    keys=['supplier_id'],
    table_type='PRIMARY',
    distributed_by=['supplier_id'],
    buckets=4,
    properties='{"replication_num": "1"}'
) }}

WITH supplier_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.supplier_id,
        COUNT(*)              AS orders_count,
        SUM(o.total_price)    AS total_purchase_amount,
        AVG(o.total_price)    AS avg_order_amount,
        MIN(o.order_date)     AS first_order_date,
        MAX(o.order_date)     AS last_order_date
    FROM {{ ref('stg_supply_orders') }} o
    GROUP BY o.supplier_id
),
supplier_contracts AS (
    SELECT
        supplier_id,
        COUNT(*)           AS contracts_count,
        SUM(total_price)   AS contracts_total_amount
    FROM {{ ref('stg_supply_contracts') }}
    GROUP BY supplier_id
),
supplier_quality AS (
    SELECT
        sr.supplier_id,
        AVG(sr.rating) AS avg_rating,
        COUNT(*)       AS ratings_count
    FROM {{ ref('stg_supplier_ratings') }} sr
    GROUP BY sr.supplier_id
)
SELECT
    s.supplier_id                              AS supplier_id,
    s.supplier_name                            AS supplier_name,
    s.country                                  AS country,
    s.city                                     AS city,
    s.region                                   AS region,
    s.rating                                   AS current_rating,
    COALESCE(sc.contracts_count, 0)            AS contracts_count,
    COALESCE(sc.contracts_total_amount, 0)     AS contracts_total_amount,
    COALESCE(so.orders_count, 0)               AS orders_count,
    COALESCE(so.total_purchase_amount, 0)      AS total_purchase_amount,
    COALESCE(so.avg_order_amount, 0)           AS avg_order_amount,
    so.first_order_date                        AS first_order_date,
    so.last_order_date                         AS last_order_date,
    COALESCE(sq.avg_rating, 0)                 AS avg_quality_rating,
    COALESCE(sq.ratings_count, 0)              AS ratings_count
FROM {{ ref('stg_suppliers') }} s
LEFT JOIN supplier_contracts sc ON sc.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
LEFT JOIN supplier_orders    so ON so.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
LEFT JOIN supplier_quality   sq ON sq.supplier_id = s.supplier_id

model.my_dbt_project.mart_supply_by_cate.name: mart_supply_by_category
model.my_dbt_project.mart_supply_by_cate.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='table',
    engine='OLAP',
    keys=['category'],
    table_type='PRIMARY',
    distributed_by=['category'],
    buckets=4,
    properties='{"replication_num": "1"}'
) }}

SELECT
    i.category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.supply_order_id)          AS orders_count,
    COUNT(*)                                   AS items_count,
    SUM(i.quantity)                            AS total_quantity,
    SUM(i.total_price)                         AS total_revenue,
    AVG(i.unit_price)                          AS avg_unit_price,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.unit_of_measure)          AS uom_variety
FROM {{ ref('stg_supply_items') }} i
GROUP BY i.category
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

model.my_dbt_project.mart_transport_anal.name: mart_transport_analysis
model.my_dbt_project.mart_transport_anal.description: Анализ маршрутов и стоимости доставки по видам транспорта.
model.my_dbt_project.mart_transport_anal.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='table',
    engine='OLAP',
    keys=['transport_mode'],
    table_type='PRIMARY',
    distributed_by=['transport_mode'],
    buckets=4,
    properties='{"replication_num": "1"}'
) }}

WITH routes AS (
    SELECT
        transport_mode,
        COUNT(*)             AS routes_count,
        SUM(distance_km)     AS total_distance_km,
        AVG(distance_km)     AS avg_distance_km,
        MIN(distance_km)     AS min_distance_km,
        MAX(distance_km)     AS max_distance_km
    FROM {{ ref('stg_transport_routes') }}
    GROUP BY transport_mode
),
shipments AS (
    SELECT
        transport_mode,
        COUNT(*)             AS shipments_count,
        SUM(shipping_cost)   AS total_shipping_cost,
        AVG(shipping_cost)   AS avg_shipping_cost,
        SUM(weight_kg)       AS total_weight_kg
    FROM {{ ref('stg_shipments') }}
    GROUP BY transport_mode
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(r.transport_mode, s.transport_mode) AS transport_mode,
    COALESCE(r.routes_count, 0)                  AS routes_count,
    COALESCE(r.total_distance_km, 0)             AS total_distance_km,
    COALESCE(r.avg_distance_km, 0)               AS avg_distance_km,
    COALESCE(s.shipments_count, 0)               AS shipments_count,
    COALESCE(s.total_shipping_cost, 0)           AS total_shipping_cost,
    COALESCE(s.avg_shipping_cost, 0)             AS avg_shipping_cost,
    COALESCE(s.total_weight_kg, 0)               AS total_weight_kg,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(r.total_distance_km, 0) > 0
        THEN ROUND(COALESCE(s.total_shipping_cost, 0) / r.total_distance_km, 4)
        ELSE NULL
    END                                          AS cost_per_km
FROM routes r
FULL OUTER JOIN shipments s USING (transport_mode)

model.my_dbt_project.mart_warehouse_acti.name: mart_warehouse_activity
model.my_dbt_project.mart_warehouse_acti.raw_code:
{{ config(
    materialized='table',
    engine='OLAP',
    keys=['warehouse_id'],
    table_type='PRIMARY',
    distributed_by=['warehouse_id'],
    buckets=4,
    properties='{"replication_num": "1"}'
) }}

WITH movements AS (
    SELECT
        warehouse_id,
        COUNT(*)                                          AS movements_count,
        SUM(quantity)                                     AS total_quantity,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN direction = 'in' THEN 1 END)      AS inbound_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN direction = 'out' THEN 1 END)     AS outbound_count,
        MIN(movement_date)                                AS first_movement,
        MAX(movement_date)                                AS last_movement
    FROM {{ ref('stg_inventory_movements') }}
    GROUP BY warehouse_id
),
deliveries AS (
    SELECT
        warehouse_id,
        COUNT(*)                                          AS deliveries_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'delivered' THEN 1 END)  AS delivered_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'returned' THEN 1 END)   AS returned_count
    FROM {{ ref('stg_deliveries') }}
    GROUP BY warehouse_id
)
SELECT
    w.warehouse_id                          AS warehouse_id,
    w.warehouse_name                        AS warehouse_name,
    w.city                                  AS city,
    w.country                               AS country,
    w.capacity_m3                           AS capacity_m3,
    COALESCE(m.movements_count, 0)          AS movements_count,
    COALESCE(m.total_quantity, 0)           AS total_quantity_moved,
    COALESCE(m.inbound_count, 0)            AS inbound_count,
    COALESCE(m.outbound_count, 0)           AS outbound_count,
    COALESCE(d.deliveries_count, 0)         AS deliveries_count,
    COALESCE(d.delivered_count, 0)          AS delivered_count,
    COALESCE(d.returned_count, 0)           AS returned_count,
    m.first_movement                        AS first_movement,
    m.last_movement                         AS last_movement
FROM {{ ref('stg_warehouses') }} w
LEFT JOIN movements  m ON m.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN deliveries d ON d.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id

macro.dbt_starrocks.starrocks__list_rela.name: starrocks__list_relations_without_caching
macro.dbt_starrocks.starrocks__list_rela.macro_sql:
{% macro starrocks__list_relations_without_caching(schema_relation) -%}
  {% call statement('list_relations_without_caching', fetch_result=True) %}
    select
      null as "database",
      tbl.table_name as name,
      tbl.table_schema as "schema",
      case when tbl.table_type = 'BASE TABLE' then 'table'
           when tbl.table_type = 'VIEW' and mv.table_name is null then 'view'
           when tbl.table_type = 'VIEW' and mv.table_name is not null then 'materialized_view'
           when tbl.table_type = 'SYSTEM VIEW' then 'system_view'
           else 'unknown' end as table_type
    from information_schema.tables tbl
    left join information_schema.materialized_views mv
    on tbl.TABLE_SCHEMA = mv.TABLE_SCHEMA
    and tbl.TABLE_NAME = mv.TABLE_NAME
    where tbl.table_schema = '{{ schema_relation.schema }}'
  {% endcall %}
  {{ return(load_result('list_relations_without_caching').table) }}
{%- endmacro %}

macro.dbt_starrocks.starrocks__get_catal.name: starrocks__get_catalog
macro.dbt_starrocks.starrocks__get_catal.macro_sql:
{% macro starrocks__get_catalog(information_schema, schemas) -%}
  {%- call statement('catalog', fetch_result=True) -%}
    with tables as (
      select
          null as "table_database",
          table_schema,
          table_name,
          case when table_type = 'BASE TABLE' then 'table'
               when table_type = 'VIEW' then 'view'
               else table_type
          end as table_type,
          null as table_owner
      from {{ information_schema }}.tables
    ),
    columns as (
      select
          null as "table_database",
          table_schema as "table_schema",
          table_name as "table_name",
          null as "table_comment",
          column_name as "column_name",
          ordinal_position as "column_index",
          data_type as "column_type",
          null as "column_comment"
      from {{ information_schema }}.columns
    )
    select
        columns.table_database,
        columns.table_schema,
        columns.table_name,
        tables.table_type,
        columns.table_comment,
        tables.table_owner,
        columns.column_name,
        columns.column_index,
        columns.column_type,
        columns.column_comment
    from tables
    join columns using (table_schema, table_name)
    where tables.table_schema not in ('information_schema', '__statistics__')
    and (
    {%- for schema in schemas -%}
      upper(tables.table_schema) = upper('{{ schema }}'){%- if not loop.last %} or {% endif -%}
    {%- endfor -%}
    )
    order by column_index
  {%- endcall -%}

  {{ return(load_result('catalog').table) }}

{%- endmacro %}

{% macro default__snapshot_merge_sql(target, source, insert_cols) -%}
    {%- set insert_cols_csv = insert_cols | join(', ') -%}

    merge into {{ target }} as DBT_INTERNAL_DEST
    using {{ source }} as DBT_INTERNAL_SOURCE
    on DBT_INTERNAL_SOURCE.dbt_scd_id = DBT_INTERNAL_DEST.dbt_scd_id

    when matched
     and DBT_INTERNAL_DEST.dbt_valid_to is null
     and DBT_INTERNAL_SOURCE.dbt_change_type in ('update', 'delete')
        then update
        set dbt_valid_to = DBT_INTERNAL_SOURCE.dbt_valid_to

    when not matched
     and DBT_INTERNAL_SOURCE.dbt_change_type = 'insert'
        then insert ({{ insert_cols_csv }})
        values ({{ insert_cols_csv }})

{% endmacro %}

macro.dbt.default__snapshot_staging_tabl.macro_sql:
{% macro default__snapshot_staging_table(strategy, source_sql, target_relation) -%}

    with snapshot_query as (

        {{ source_sql }}

    ),

    snapshotted_data as (

        select *,
            {{ strategy.unique_key }} as dbt_unique_key

        from {{ target_relation }}
        where dbt_valid_to is null

    ),

    insertions_source_data as (

        select
            *,
            {{ strategy.unique_key }} as dbt_unique_key,
            {{ strategy.updated_at }} as dbt_updated_at,
            {{ strategy.updated_at }} as dbt_valid_from,
            nullif({{ strategy.updated_at }}, {{ strategy.updated_at }}) as dbt_valid_to,
            {{ strategy.scd_id }} as dbt_scd_id

        from snapshot_query
    ),

    updates_source_data as (

        select
            *,
            {{ strategy.unique_key }} as dbt_unique_key,
            {{ strategy.updated_at }} as dbt_updated_at,
            {{ strategy.updated_at }} as dbt_valid_from,
            {{ strategy.updated_at }} as dbt_valid_to

        from snapshot_query
    ),

    {%- if strategy.invalidate_hard_deletes %}

    deletes_source_data as (

        select
            *,
            {{ strategy.unique_key }} as dbt_unique_key
        from snapshot_query
    ),
    {% endif %}

    insertions as (

        select
            'insert' as dbt_change_type,
            source_data.*

        from insertions_source_data as source_data
        left outer join snapshotted_data on snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key = source_data.dbt_unique_key
        where snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key is null
           or (
                snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key is not null
            and (
                {{ strategy.row_changed }}
            )
        )

    ),

    updates as (

        select
            'update' as dbt_change_type,
            source_data.*,
            snapshotted_data.dbt_scd_id

        from updates_source_data as source_data
        join snapshotted_data on snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key = source_data.dbt_unique_key
        where (
            {{ strategy.row_changed }}
        )
    )

    {%- if strategy.invalidate_hard_deletes -%}
    ,

    deletes as (

        select
            'delete' as dbt_change_type,
            source_data.*,
            {{ snapshot_get_time() }} as dbt_valid_from,
            {{ snapshot_get_time() }} as dbt_updated_at,
            {{ snapshot_get_time() }} as dbt_valid_to,
            snapshotted_data.dbt_scd_id

        from snapshotted_data
        left join deletes_source_data as source_data on snapshotted_data.dbt_unique_key = source_data.dbt_unique_key
        where source_data.dbt_unique_key is null
    )
    {%- endif %}

    select * from insertions
    union all
    select * from updates
    {%- if strategy.invalidate_hard_deletes %}
    union all
    select * from deletes
    {%- endif %}

{%- endmacro %}

doc.dbt.__overview__.block_contents:
### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.
